test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indians made the country proud in Malaysia by being the fastest Indian to complete the Ironman Malaysia triathlon in record time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaroop Singh Kuntal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Army's officer** Lt. Col. Swaroop Singh Kuntal became the fastest Indian to complete Ironman Malaysia in a record timing of 12 hours and 14 minutes**.
 
• The Ironman Malaysia was organised on October 26 on Langkawi Island in Malaysia. Athletes from all over the world participated.
 
• Ironman consists of **3.8 km of sea swimming followed by 180 km of cycling and finally 42.2 km of running**.
 
• All events are required to be done in **a cut-off time of 17 hours**.
 
• Ironman Malaysia is one of the toughest competitions because it has **an elevation of around 3,000m on the 180 km cycling course**.
 
• During cycling maximum temperature reached 38°C and while running it reached 35°C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swaroop Singh Kuntal**

 
 
• Kuntal is posted in Jhansi. He is a paratrooper and an IITian.**​**
 
• Earlier, he participated in many marathons and ultra-marathons.
 
• He won** a 12-hour stadium run at Chandigarh where he covered 118.7 km**.
 
• Kuntal has **represented Uttar Pradesh in the 23rd National Road Cycling Championship in 2018**.
 
• Earlier in September 2018, **he won Ironman at Jaipur International Triathlon.**
 
• Kuntal trained very hard to participate in Ironman Malaysia and his preparation included** extensive running, cycling, swimming, and strength training.**
